title: lactuca quercina subsp. wilhemsiana
intro: Lactuca quercina subsp. wilhemsiana, commonly known as Wild Lettuce, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the relief of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Wild Lettuce include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help in calming the nervous system and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Lactuca quercina subsp. wilhemsiana include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and lactucarium, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
